Rooftop bar Saigon the park
Sep 2026 • Solo
Walked through the city and searched for a rooftop bar on maps and found this place. From the street it looked like a standard city hotel, but the bar at the top and especially the rooftop bar was really beautiful. You have a beautiful view of the city in the evening with the skyscrapers as the highlight. They also have an extensive cocktail menu and the quality was really top!

Definitely a recommendation to go
